AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Disease Control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Disease Control.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Disease Control.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Disease Control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Disease Control.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ornamental Cropping? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ornamental Cropping.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ornamental Cropping.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Ornamental Cropping.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ornamental Cropping.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Nutrition.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Nutrition.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Powered Agricultural Implements? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Powered Agricultural Implements.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Powered Agricultural Implements.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Powered Agricultural Implements.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Powered Agricultural Implements.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agri- business Accounts? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agri- business Accounts.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agri- business Accounts.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agri- business Accounts.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agri- business Accounts.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Breeding? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Breeding.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Breeding.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Breeding.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Breeding.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forage Crops? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forage Crops.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forage Crops.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forage Crops.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Forage Crops.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Non- conventional Livestock and Companion Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Urban and peri-urban Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Agricultural Implements and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Agricultural Biotechnology and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Business and Career Opportunities in Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
